agent_changes.description: Can now be rotated while holding down ALT-FIRE. ACTIVATE now swaps Turret direction.

bug_fixes: Agent
Killjoy
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where an enemy’s Nanoswarm could remain invisible if you moved too quickly in and out of its detection range.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where an enemy’s Nanoswarm could remain invisible to you after Killjoy is suppressed.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where an enemy’s Nanoswarm would not reveal to you if you are in an Intangible state, like during Yoru’s Dimensional Drift or Reyna’s Dismiss
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where Nanoswarm’s disabled effects sometimes wouldn’t play when Killjoy is suppressed.
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Turret’s vision cone would disappear from the minimap if the player right-clicks.
Jett
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Drift’s passive gliding SFX was audible from the other side of Astra’s Cosmic Divide.
Harbor
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Storm Surge could briefly persist into the next round when cast right before a round ends.
Fade
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Nightfall’s minimap indicator was slightly smaller than the actual ability.
Chamber
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Trademark would play its reactivation SFX twice if Chamber had Suppress expiring on him.
Skye
Bugfix Fixed an observer bug where Seekers would not show on the minimap when Skye is an attacker.
Battle Pass
Fixed an issue where hitting ESC will cause the Battlepass elements to disappear/reappear instead of taking you back a page.
Maps
Breeze
Bugfix Buff Various collision improvements to allow Vyse’s Arc Rose and Cypher’s Spycam to be placed on the walls.
Bugfix Fixed multiple minor art bugs around the map.
General Updates
Bugfix Minor adjustments to the geometry in a few high traffic gameplay spots to eliminate unintended gaps on the map.
Store
Fixed an issue where the background for the accessories store was missing.
Fixed an issue where the Reaver Bandit shows up incorrectly as a limited edition item
Battle Pass
The scroll wheel currently will not work when navigating between the tiers on the battlepass or event pass. This will be fixed in patch 12.05.
Performance

Since the release of patch 12.03, some players have been experiencing significant stuttering. We have deployed a hotfix that partially fixes the stutters and are working on a more robust fix for Patch 12.04.
The End of Game and Career screens have been revamped
The Progression, Summary, and Timeline tabs now have an updated layout.
After Competitive matches, a new Rank summary screen displays details about your RR gains or losses.
The Career and Friends’ Career pages have been updated with a new UI.
Take a breather and get your team ready –- the next Premier Stage starts at the beginning of Act 2 in 12.05!
Adjustment Stage V26A2 will run for six weeks of matches instead of the usual seven
Teams with a Premier Score of at least 500 qualify for Playoffs on April 16
Matches start on Wednesday, March 18, so make sure your team is ready to go!

Replaced the Battlepass tab in the top navigation bar with a Progression tab. Clicking in will bring you to a Progression Hub, which provides an at-a-glance view of your overall progression. This can include the Battlepass, weekly missions, active event passes and other progress opportunities as relevant.
